citation_policy.rule: Every citation records repo + branch + commit sha + path (+ line range where applicable).
consequence: PUBLISHED 2026-08-01. All three source repositories now have a public snapshot, so citations to
them resolve to real permalinks a reader can open. Citations into any source NOT listed above
(the math workbench) still render as UNRESOLVABLE and say so on their face, because a citation a
reader cannot open is an appeal to authority and the honest response is to mark it.
TWO COMMITS, AND THE DIFFERENCE MATTERS. A citation records the PRIVATE source commit the bytes
were ingested from — that is the provenance, and it is what the digest was taken over. The
permalink resolves against the PUBLIC SNAPSHOT commit, which is a single fresh commit holding the
same tree. They are different sha values naming the same content, and both are recorded here
rather than collapsed into one, because pretending a snapshot is the original commit would be a
THE SNAPSHOTS ARE NOT BYTE-IDENTICAL TO THE PRIVATE TREE, IN 17 PLACES. Third-party client
identifiers were replaced with '[redacted: client-identifier]' before publication — 12
occurrences in uni-minecraft, 5 in uni-flagellum-motor-stack, 0 in uni-cookbook. Those strings
name a client's organisation, personnel and internal tickets; they are not the author's to
publish. A citation landing on one of those files opens the redacted line, not the original.
Nothing else was removed from any snapshot.

His answers lived in a c

THE SURFACE, not the endpoint -- verify_decision proves the route's fences, chain and refusals; this proves the properties that only matter because a HUMAN uses it, and that no amount of correct server code supplies. THE FIRST ONE IS MECHANICAL AND WOULD HAVE RUINED THE FEATURE: track.html rewrites app.innerHTML wholesale on a 10-second setInterval, so a textarea living on the main page would have a half-typed answer to 'the writer's key on node2' destroyed mid-sentence, repeatedly, with nothing recoverable. /decide is therefore a separate page and this gate fails if ANY timer appears in it --

THE HUD WAS GETTING GREENER AS ITS SENSOR ROTTED. viewer/hud/hud_user_sight.ps1 has pushed nothing since 2026-07-14 and the live snapshot still reports user_sight.fresh=false with last_push_at=null. Before this gate, hud.html's renderSight printed 'all fabric resonant -- no contradictions, no rot, no runaway' for that exact payload: a DEAD DETECTOR REPORTED AS HARMONY, on the one surface whose whole job is to tell the operator when something is wrong. The native widget already had the rule right (RenderDecisions.cs:53-65 prints 'user detectors NOT REPORTING') and its C# test asserts it -- but

EVIDENCE THAT CANNOT LEAVE THE BOX IT WAS MADE ON IS EVIDENCE ONLY TO THE BOX. Every receipt in docs/receipts/ and every object in evidence/control_plane/objects/ is retrievable ONLY through this repository's own conventions -- there is no portable container, no declared payload, no way to hand a stranger a directory and have them establish that it holds what it says it holds. viewer/bag.cjs builds RFC 8493 BagIt 1.0 packs, zero dependencies, and this gate refuses to believe them.
